```sql
WITH l AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           o.id  AS order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o           ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT product_id, order_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS q,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS r
      FROM l
     GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
per_product AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)       AS order_count,
           sum(q)::bigint AS quantity,
           sum(r)         AS revenue_cents
      FROM per_order
     GROUP BY product_id
),
per_variant AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM l) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       pv.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN per_variant pv ON pv.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN products p     ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY pp.quantity DESC, pp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De dure, naar schijf lopende sort op (p.id, o.id) voor `count(DISTINCT)` wordt vervangen door hash-aggregaties: eerst per (product, order), daarna per product, en apart een telling van de distincte varianten. Producten worden pas na de aggregatie gejoind, op ongeveer 1.750 rijen in plaats van 81.000. De types blijven gelijk aan het origineel: `quantity` wordt teruggecast naar bigint en `revenue_cents` blijft numeric.
